framework.cell: fcc-type 2x supercell of the cubic LTA cell, 144 atoms, heights 13.82 A

gm: planar Pt9 (16 Pt-Pt bonds 2.54-2.60 A) lying flat on the alpha-cage wall, anchored by two Pt-O 2.26 A contacts, Pt-Si >= 3.07 A; binding to the frozen framework -4.3 eV
notes: Pilot: 10 seeds x BH/RS, 40k steps (campaign pilot-bze1-v2). Size scan (BH/RS ERT): Pt6 2.4k/6.6k and Pt8 2.3k/6.2k too easy, Pt10 165k/116k too hard, Pt9 chosen. 10/20 runs reached the GM (energy spread 1.3 meV). A distinct adsorption mode of the same planar isomer (Pt-O 2.15 A, 0.3 A further off-centre) lies only +0.021-0.024 eV higher (5 runs), so e_tol = 0.01 eV instead of 0.02 to keep it from counting as a hit. Budget = 3 x median BH hit (13.8k) = 41k steps (~6 min/run). NEP89 is not fitted to metal/zeolite interfaces; the -4.3 eV cluster-framework binding is probably overestimated.
